ns2:section.sectionText: HOUSING/RESIDENTAL LIFE Paraprofessional Staff Course. Course is restricted to Housing Paraprofessional Staff Members. Students eligible for registration in this course will be notified. 10 Week second half-session class. Meets in 2005 SDRP. 2 hours (letter-graded) credit. Class begins with a mandatory retreat on Saturday, September 24, 2016. Regular weekly class meetings begin Tuesday, September 27, 2016. See: http://www.housing.illinois.edu/aboutus/staff-employment/parapro. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call Residential Life or Nathan Sanden in Housing at 333-0770 or email nsanden@illinois.edu
